children: Xeris Biopharma hosted an XP-8121 Program Overview and said the Phase 3 Cornerstone trial is on track to initiate by year-end, with topline results expected in late 2028 and potential U.S. approval and launch anticipated in 2030.
Announced XP-8121 program overview webinar and furnished investor presentation and press release as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2.
Cornerstone Phase 3: 500 participants, >50 U.S. sites, 54-week randomized study to show therapeutic equivalence vs daily oral levothyroxine.
Company expects Cornerstone to start by year-end 2026, topline data in late 2028, and potential FDA approval and commercial launch in 2030.
Planned complementary studies: Capstone pediatric dosing study, Touchstone for patients with inconsistent control, plus ongoing real-world evidence generation.
Company projects XP-8121 peak net revenue potential of $1–3 billion if approved and highlights commercial readiness using existing infrastructure.
